description: This file defines the UserRepository class, which manages User entities using an in-memory concurrent map, providing methods for saving, retrieving, and checking existence of users.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing thread-safe CRUD operations for User objects stored in-memory.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a User object to the repository, assigning a new ID if necessary.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its unique ID, if present.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Finds a User by username in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: existsByUsername
methods.description: Checks whether a User with the specified username exists.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all User objects stored in the repository.
